steps.command: ls -la /app/documents/ && find /app/documents -type f | head -50
which pdftotext pdfinfo tesseract python3; python3 -c "import PIL; print('PIL ok')" 2>/dev/null; file /app/documents/* 2>/dev/null | head -50
python3 -c "import sys; print(sys.version)"; pip list 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "pdf|image|tesseract|ocr|pillow|opencv|pytesseract|fitz|mupdf"
ls /usr/bin | grep -iE "pdf|tesseract|convert|magick|gs$|ocr" ; echo "---"; cat /etc/os-release | head -5
cd /app/documents && for f in *.pdf; do echo "=== $f ==="; head -c 300 "$f" | strings | head -20; done
which node npm npx bun deno ruby perl php java go gcc; ls /opt; ls /opt/pi-stock/node_modules | head -30
ls -la /app; ls -la /usr/local/bin; ls /opt/pi-stock/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/node_modules 2>/dev/null | head
cat /etc/apt/sources.list.d/* 2>/dev/null | head; apt-cache policy poppler-utils tesseract-ocr 2>/dev/null | head -30
find /opt/pi-stock/node_modules -maxdepth 2 -type d \( -iname "*pdf*" -o -iname "*tesseract*" -o -iname "*ocr*" -o -iname "*sharp*" -o -iname "*jimp*" \) | head -50
ls /opt/node/bin; /opt/node/bin/node -v; /opt/node/bin/npm -v 2>/dev/null; ls /opt/pi-stock/node_modules | grep -iE "pdf|tesseract|ocr|sharp|jimp|canvas|image"
apt-get update -qq 2>&1 | tail -5; echo EXIT:$?
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq poppler-utils tesseract-ocr imagemagick >/tmp/apt.log 2>&1; echo EXIT:$?; tail -20 /tmp/apt.log
mkdir -p /tmp/text; cd /app/documents; for f in *.pdf; do echo "=== $f ==="; pdftotext -layout "$f" - 2>/dev/null; done
cd /app/documents; for f in *.jpg; do echo "=== $f ==="; tesseract "$f" - 2>/dev/null; done

cd /app/documents; for f in dx0AWchV01ZJ.pdf dvkRkFVFhHga.pdf T0r6Ou8zvqTA.pdf UsN9tVTKskms.pdf wIQEB5nR79b2.pdf; do echo "=== $f ==="; pdftotext -layout "$f" - | grep -inE "invoice|purchase|order|total|vat|tax|gst|amount due"; done
cd /app/documents; for f in *.pdf; do echo "=== $f ==="; pdfinfo "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "Title|Subject|Creator|Producer|Pages"; done
cd /app/documents; for f in *.pdf; do echo "=== $f ==="; pdftotext "$f" - 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,8p'; done
